preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.split('\n')[1::2]])
preconditions.description: The number of problems in each test case is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(a) <= n for a in line.split()) for n, line in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.split('\n')[1::2]], stdin.split('\n')[2::2]))
preconditions.description: Each problem tag is between 1 and the number of problems in the test case.
The sum of the number of problems over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == '-1' or (isinstance(return_value[i], int) and return_value[i] >= 0) for i in range(len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 or a non-negative integer representing the minimum cost.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == '-1' or (isinstance(return_value[i], int) and return_value[i] <= n-1) for i, n in zip(range(len(return_value)), [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.split('\n')[1::2]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output cost is at most n-1 if a valid permutation exists.
